summary: GigaMedia Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing its second-quarter 2026 financial results. The report discloses an IP collaboration boosting revenues and the conversion of Aeolus Robotics corporate bonds into preferred shares, increasing ownership to 33.35% and reclassifying the investment to equity-method. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation, though the equity-method change and deemed disposal gain reflect an investment action. The filing does not trigger a category under the defined special situations; it is an ordinary periodic report.
